purpose: Curated candidates for controlled capability federation; not a declaration that packages are installed or production-approved.

rules: Verify exact package/repository, license, maintainer provenance, release health, vulnerabilities, supported runtimes, and transitive dependencies before adoption.
Pin versions and hashes in a lockfile after acceptance.
External code runs with least privilege and without production credentials during evaluation.
Adoption requires tests, failure/recovery evidence, and an explicit authority decision.

candidates.name: Model Context Protocol Python SDK
candidates.adoption: Build a minimal read-only VX adapter; do not enable arbitrary tools.

candidates.name: OpenAI Agents SDK
candidates.role: Optional agent orchestration, tools, handoffs, guardrails and tracing
candidates.adoption: Keep behind provider adapter; do not replace VX governance/runtime.

candidates.name: OpenTelemetry Python
candidates.adoption: Add instrumentation at boundaries; avoid leaking prompts, secrets, or payloads.

candidates.name: Temporal Python SDK
candidates.role: Durable long-running workflow execution and retries
candidates.adoption: Evaluate for durable orchestration; keep authority and proof gates in VX.

candidates.name: LangGraph
candidates.adoption: Compare with existing VX state machine before adding; avoid duplicate orchestration.

candidates.name: Pydantic
candidates.adoption: Already declared in requirements; audit pinned range and schemas before upgrades.

candidates.name: FastAPI
candidates.role: HTTP API surface for reviewed adapters
candidates.adoption: Already declared in requirements; expose only authenticated, scoped endpoints.

candidates.name: NetworkX
candidates.adoption: Already declared in requirements; benchmark graph size and determinism requirements.

candidates.name: pytest

candidates.name: Ruff

candidates.name: Hypothesis

candidates.name: Semgrep
candidates.adoption: Start with CI scanning and reviewed rules; findings require triage.
